items.jyutping: ni1 fo3 mui4 gwai3 hoi1 faa1 zi1 cin4 zeoi3 hou2 si1 fei4.
items.meaning: This rose is best fertilized before it flowers.

items.sentence: 阿媽話陽台啲植物要定期施肥。
items.jyutping: aa3 maa1 waa6 joeng4 toi4 di1 zing3 mat6 jiu3 ding6 kei4 si1 fei4.
items.meaning: Mum says the balcony plants need regular fertilizing.

items.sentence: 園丁每個月都會做剪枝，保持棵樹生長得整齊。
items.jyutping: jyun4 ding1 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 wui5 zou6 zin2 zi1, bong2 ci4 to2 syu6 sang1 zoeng2 dak1 zing2 cai4.
items.meaning: The gardener prunes the branches every month to keep the tree growing neatly.

items.sentence: 呢棵玫瑰太密，要剪枝先至會出得靚。
items.jyutping: ni1 fo2 mui4 gwai3 taai3 mat6, jiu3 zin2 zi1 sin1 zi3 wui5 ceot1 dak1 leng3.
items.meaning: This rose bush is too dense; it needs pruning before it will grow well.

items.sentence: 如果你想植物健康啲，就要學識點樣剪枝。
items.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 zing3 muk6 gin6 hong4 hang2 di1, zau6 jiu3 hok6 sik1 dim2 joeng6 zin2 zi1.
items.meaning: If you want your plants to be healthier, you need to learn how to prune branches.

items.sentence: 佢喺後園幫阿媽剪枝，順便執埋啲枯葉。
items.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 hau6 jyun4 bong1 aa3 maa1 zin2 zi1, seon6 bin6 zap1 maai4 di1 fu1 jip6.
items.meaning: He helped his mother prune the branches in the backyard and also picked up the dead leaves.

items.sentence: 我今日要去後園拔草。
items.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 hau6 jyun4 bat6 cou2.
items.meaning: I need to go to the backyard and pull weeds today.

items.sentence: 雨後啲草生得好快，我成日都要拔草。
items.jyutping: jyu5 hau6 di1 cou2 sang1 dak1 hou2 faai3, ngo5 sing4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 bat6 cou2.
items.meaning: After the rain, the weeds grow very fast, so I always have to pull them.

items.sentence: 阿媽叫我幫手拔草，順便鬆下泥。
items.jyutping: aa3 ma1 giu3 ngo5 bong1 sau2 bat6 cou2, seon6 bin6 sung1 haa5 nai4.
items.meaning: Mom asked me to help pull weeds and loosen the soil at the same time.

items.sentence: 天氣唔太熱，我哋下晝去公園旁邊拔草。
items.jyutping: tin1 hei3 m4 taai3 jit6, ngo5 dei6 haa6 zau3 heoi3 gung1 jyun4 pong4 bin1 bat6 cou2.
items.meaning: The weather isn’t too hot, so let’s go pull weeds beside the park this afternoon.

items.sentence: 種花之前，先要鬆土。
items.jyutping: zung2 faa1 zyun1 cin4, sin1 jiu3 sung1 tou2.
items.meaning: Before planting flowers, you need to loosen the soil first.

items.sentence: 啲泥太硬，落水都唔容易入。要先鬆土。
items.jyutping: di1 nai4 taai3 ngaang6, lok6 seoi2 dou1 m4 jung6 ji6 jap6. jiu3 sin1 sung1 tou2.
items.meaning: The soil is too hard, so water does not soak in easily. You need to loosen it first.

items.sentence: 阿媽成日叫我幫佢喺菜盆度鬆土。
items.jyutping: aa3 maa1 sing4 jat6 giu3 ngo5 bong1 keoi5 hai2 coi3 pun4 dou6 sung1 tou2.
items.meaning: My mum often asks me to loosen the soil in the vegetable pot.

items.sentence: 落完雨之後，花圃表面有少少結實，記得鬆土。
items.jyutping: lok6 jyun4 jyu5 zi1 hau6, faa1 pou5 biu2 min6 jau5 siu2 siu2 git3 sat6, gei3 dak1 sung1 tou2.
items.meaning: After it rains, the surface of the flower bed gets a bit compacted, so remember to loosen the soil.

items.sentence: 我諗呢棵龜背竹要換盆喇。
items.jyutping: ngo5 lam2 ni1 fo1 gwai1 bui3 zuk1 jiu3 wun6 pun4 laa3.
items.meaning: I think this monstera needs repotting.

items.sentence: 三個月前我幫佢換盆，依家長得好快。
items.jyutping: saam1 go3 jyut6 cin4 ngo5 bong1 keoi5 wun6 pun4, ji1 gaa1 zoeng2 dak1 hou2 faai3.
items.meaning: I repotted it three months ago, and now it’s growing fast.

items.sentence: 盆太細喇，快啲換盆啦。
items.jyutping: pun4 taai3 sai3 laa3, faai3 di1 wun6 pun4 laa1.
items.meaning: The pot is too small, so repot it soon.

items.sentence: 如果你想佢開花多啲，換盆之後記得加新泥。
items.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 keoi5 hoi1 faa1 do1 di1, wun6 pun4 zi1 hau6 gei3 dak1 gaa1 san1 nai4.
items.meaning: If you want it to flower more, remember to add fresh soil after repotting.

items.sentence: 我哋喺春天播種。
items.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 ceon1 tin1 bo3 zung2.
items.meaning: We sow seeds in spring.

items.sentence: 佢喺花盆入面播種。
items.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 faa1 pun4 jap6 min6 bo3 zung2.
items.meaning: He/She sowed seeds in the flower pot.

items.sentence: 老師教小朋友點樣播種。
items.jyutping: lou5si1 gaau3 siu2 pang4 jau4 dim2 joeng6 bo3 zung2.
items.meaning: The teacher taught the children how to sow seeds.

items.sentence: 如果想種菜，就要先播種。
items.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 soeng2 zung3 coi3, zau6 jiu3 sin1 bo3 zung2.
items.meaning: If you want to grow vegetables, you need to sow the seeds first.

items.sentence: 啲葉開始變黃，可能係水太多。
items.jyutping: di1 jip6 hoi1 ci2 bin3 wong4, ho2 nang4 hai6 seoi2 taai3 do1.
items.meaning: The leaves are starting to turn yellow; it may be because there is too much water.

items.sentence: 呢盆花嘅葉點解變黃咗？
items.jyutping: ni1 pun4 faa1 ge3 jip6 dim2 gaai2 bin3 wong4 zo2?
items.meaning: Why have the leaves of this potted plant turned yellow?

items.sentence: 如果泥土太乾，枝葉都可能會變黃。
items.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nai4 tou2 taai3 gon1, zi1 jip6 dou1 ho2 nang4 wui5 bin3 wong4.
items.meaning: If the soil is too dry, the stems and leaves may also turn yellow.

items.sentence: 佢種嘅番茄葉變黃，應該要檢查下肥料。
items.jyutping: keoi5 zung2 ge3 faan1 ke2 jip6 bin3 wong4, jing1 goi1 jiu3 gim2 caa4 haa5 fei4 liu2.
items.meaning: The tomato leaves he grew have turned yellow, so he should check the fertilizer.

items.sentence: 呢束花好快就凋謝咗。
items.jyutping: ni1 zuk1 faa1 hou2 faai3 zau6 diu1 ze6 zo2
items.meaning: This bouquet wilted very quickly.

items.sentence: 太陽太猛，啲葉都開始凋謝。
items.jyutping: taai3 joeng4 taai3 maang5, di1 jip6 dou1 hoi1 ci2 diu1 ze6
items.meaning: The sun was too strong, and the leaves started to wilt.

items.sentence: 如果唔澆水，盆栽好容易凋謝。
items.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 m4 giu1 seoi2, pun4 zoi1 hou2 jung4 ji6 diu1 ze6
items.meaning: If you don’t water it, the potted plant will wilt easily.

items.sentence: 青春好似花一樣，轉眼間就會凋謝。
items.jyutping: cing1 ceon1 hou2 ci5 faa1 jat1 joeng6, zyun2 ngaan5 gaan1 zau6 wui5 diu1 ze6
items.meaning: Youth is like a flower; it can fade in the blink of an eye.

items.sentence: 呢棵玫瑰俾人忘記咗澆水，依家睇落奄奄一息。
items.jyutping: ni1 to5 mui4 gwai3 bei2 jan4 mong4 gei3 zo2 gaau1 seoi2, ji1 gaa3 tai2 lok6 jim1 jim1 jat1 sik1.
items.meaning: The rose was forgotten and not watered; now it looks barely alive.

items.sentence: 落咗幾日大雨之後，盆仙人掌已經奄奄一息。
items.jyutping: lok6 zo2 gei2 jat6 daai6 jyu5 zi1 hau6, pun4 sin1 jan4 zoeng2 ji5 ging1 jim1 jim1 jat1 sik1.
items.meaning: After several days of heavy rain, the potted cactus is barely alive.

items.sentence: 嗰隻流浪貓俾人救返嚟嗰陣，已經奄奄一息。
items.jyutping: go2 zek3 lau4 long6 maau1 bei2 jan4 gau3 faan1 lai4 go2 zan6, ji5 ging1 jim1 jim1 jat1 sik1.
items.meaning: When that stray cat was rescued, it was already barely alive.

items.sentence: 佢成晚冇瞓，返工嗰陣成個人都奄奄一息。
items.jyutping: keoi5 sing4 maan5 mou5 fan3, faan1 gung1 go2 zan6 sing4 go3 jan4 dou1 jim1 jim1 jat1 sik1.
items.meaning: He didn’t sleep all night and was utterly exhausted at work.

items.sentence: 呢棵盆栽睇落好健康。
items.jyutping: ni1 fo2 pun4 zoi1 tai2 lok6 hou2 gin6 hong1
items.meaning: This potted plant looks very healthy.

items.sentence: 如果土壤夠濕，植物會更加健康。
items.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 tou2 joeng5 gau3 sap1, zik6 mou6 wui5 gang3 gaa1 gin6 hong1
items.meaning: If the soil is moist enough, the plant will be healthier.

items.sentence: 我想買啲健康嘅花返屋企。
items.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 di1 gin6 hong1 ge3 faa1 faan1 uk1 hei2
items.meaning: I want to buy some healthy flowers to bring home.

items.sentence: 定期施肥可以令植物保持健康。
items.jyutping: ding6 kei4 si1 fei4 ho2 ji5 ling6 zik6 mou6 bou2 ci4 gin6 hong1
items.meaning: Regular fertilising can help plants stay healthy.

items.sentence: 呢棵玫瑰生得好壯。
items.jyutping: ni1 hok3 mui4 gwai3 sang1 dak1 hou2 zong3.
items.meaning: This rose is growing very vigorously.

items.sentence: 啲菜苗今日睇落幾壯。
items.jyutping: di1 coi3 miu4 gam1 jat6 tai2 lok6 gei2 zong3.
items.meaning: The vegetable seedlings look quite healthy today.

items.sentence: 佢啲蘭花開完之後都仲好壯。
items.jyutping: keoi5 di1 laan4 faa1 hoi1 jyun4 zi1 hau6 dou1 zung6 hou2 zong3.
items.meaning: His orchids are still in good shape after blooming.

items.sentence: 落咗肥之後，棵樹即刻壯咗。
items.jyutping: lok6 zo2 fei4 zi1 hau6, po1 syu6 zik1 haak3 zong3 zo2.
items.meaning: After fertilizing, the tree became stronger right away.

items.sentence: 我想買個新花盆種多肉。
items.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 go3 san1 faa1 pun4 zung2 do1 juk6.
items.meaning: I want to buy a new flowerpot for succulents.

items.sentence: 呢個花盆太細，唔夠位。
items.jyutping: ni1 go3 faa1 pun4 taai3 sai3, m4 gau3 wai2.
items.meaning: This flowerpot is too small; there isn’t enough space.

items.sentence: 佢將啲蘭花放喺窗邊個花盆度。
items.jyutping: keoi5 zoeng1 di1 laan4 faa1 fong3 hai2 coeng1 bin1 go3 faa1 pun4 dou6.
items.meaning: He put the orchids in the flowerpot by the window.

items.sentence: 落完雨之後，花盆入面有好多水。
items.jyutping: lok6 jyun4 jyu5 zi1 hau6, faa1 pun4 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 seoi2.
items.meaning: After the rain, there was a lot of water in the flowerpot.

items.sentence: 呢盆花要換土壤先會長得好。
items.jyutping: ni1 bun2 faa1 jiu3 wun6 tou2 joeng6 sin1 wui5 zoeng2 dak1 hou2.
items.meaning: This potted flower needs new soil to grow well.

items.sentence: 種菜之前，要先整鬆啲土壤。
items.jyutping: zung2 coi3 zi1 cin4, jiu3 sin1 zing2 sung1 di1 tou2 joeng6.
items.meaning: Before planting vegetables, loosen the soil first.

items.sentence: 呢度嘅土壤好肥沃，好適合種樹。
items.jyutping: ni1 dou6 ge3 tou2 joeng6 hou2 fei4 juk1, hou2 sik1 hap6 zung2 syu6.
items.meaning: The soil here is very fertile and suitable for planting trees.

items.sentence: 落雨之後，土壤會濕晒。
items.jyutping: lok6 jyu5 zi1 hau6, tou2 joeng6 wui5 sap1 saai3.
items.meaning: After rain, the soil becomes completely wet.

items.sentence: 我今日去花墟買咗包肥料。
items.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 heoi3 faa1 heoi1 maai5 zo2 baau1 fei4 liu6.
items.meaning: I went to the flower market today and bought a bag of fertilizer.

items.sentence: 呢盆植物要加少少肥料。
items.jyutping: ni1 pun4 zik6 mat6 jiu3 gaa1 siu2 siu2 fei4 liu6.
items.meaning: This plant needs a little fertilizer.

items.sentence: 阿媽叫我幫佢淋肥料。
items.jyutping: aa3 maa1 giu3 ngo5 bong1 keoi5 lam4 fei4 liu6.
items.meaning: My mom asked me to water in the fertilizer for her.

items.sentence: 落太多肥料會傷到棵菜。
items.jyutping: lok6 taai3 do1 fei4 liu6 wui5 soeng1 dou3 po1 coi3.
items.meaning: Using too much fertilizer can damage the vegetables.

items.sentence: 佢喺花園用剪刀修剪枝葉。
items.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 faa1 jyun4 jung6 zin2 dou1 sau1 zin2 zi1 jip6.
items.meaning: He/She uses shears to trim the branches and leaves in the garden.

items.sentence: 請借把剪刀俾我。
items.jyutping: cing2 ze2 baa2 zin2 dou1 bei2 ngo5.
items.meaning: Please lend me a pair of scissors.

items.sentence: 媽媽用剪刀剪開包裝。
items.jyutping: maa1 maa1 jung6 zin2 dou1 zin2 hoi1 baau1 zong1.
items.meaning: Mum uses scissors to cut open the packaging.

items.sentence: 園丁每日都會帶剪刀。
items.jyutping: jyun4 ding1 mui5 jat6 dou1 wui5 daai3 zin2 dou1.
items.meaning: The gardener brings shears every day.

items.sentence: 請你拎個水壺嚟淋花。
items.jyutping: cing2 nei5 ling1 go3 seoi2 wu4 lai4 jam1 faa1
items.meaning: Please bring the watering can to water the flowers.

items.sentence: 呢個水壺太細，淋唔到後面嗰盆植物。
items.jyutping: ni1 go3 seoi2 wu4 taai3 sai3, jam1 m4 dou2 hau6 min6 go2 pun4 zing3 mat6
items.meaning: This watering can is too small; it can't water the plant at the back.

items.sentence: 屋企陽台種咗幾盆草，我買咗個新水壺。
items.jyutping: uk1 kei2 joeng4 toi4 cung3 zo2 gei2 pun4 cou2, ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 san1 seoi2 wu4
items.meaning: There are a few pots of plants on the balcony, so I bought a new watering can.

items.sentence: 你可唔可以幫我裝滿個水壺？
items.jyutping: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 zong1 mun5 go3 seoi2 wu4
items.meaning: Can you help me fill up the watering can?
